<issue>
Path normalization returns reversed paths

#### Description

When using path normalization functions in astroid, paths are being returned in reverse order. This affects module resolution and path-based operations throughout the codebase.

#### Steps/Code to Reproduce

```python
from astroid import modutils

# Test path normalization
path = "/some/normal/path"
normalized = modutils._cache_normalize_path_(path)
print(f"Original: {path}")
print(f"Normalized: {normalized}")
# Expected: /some/normal/path (or similar normalized form)
# Actual: htap/lamron/emos/ (reversed)
```

The issue manifests when working with module paths and can be observed in various module utility functions that rely on path normalization.
</issue>
